figurative_meaning_en: An extremely thin and emaciated person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই কৃশ যে গিরগিটির মতো দেখায়।
ভাতের অভাবে তার শরীর গিরগিটির মতো শুকিয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so thin that he looks like a chameleon.
Due to lack of food, his body has withered like a chameleon.
note: The idiom draws from the slender, elongated body of the chameleon, common in Bengali rural folklore.
